question: Fill in the blank marked [B] using the most appropriate option.
solution:
The correct answer is '**turned**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is written in the past tense, as indicated by phrases like "lost their way" and "became afraid."
 
• The verb in blank [B] should also be in the past tense to maintain consistency.
 
• "**Turned**" is the correct choice as it correctly follows the past tense structure of the passage.
 
• Other options ("**does turn**", "**were turning**", "**have turned**") do not fit the past tense narrative properly.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Does turn (वर्तमान काल): "Does turn" is in the present tense, which does not fit the past tense narrative.
 
• Were turning (अपूर्ण भूतकाल): "Were turning" suggests an ongoing action, but the sentence requires a simple past action.
 
• Have turned (पूर्ण भूतकाल): "Have turned" is present perfect tense, which does not fit the past story structure.
